title: Debug goroutine leak and WaitGroup misuse in Go — 3 turns
description: HTTP client leaks goroutine by not closing response body. WaitGroup is misused (Done called before Add). Fix both bugs and run go vet.

task_spec.prompt: The `FetchOne` function in `fetcher/fetcher.go` leaks the HTTP response body — `resp.Body` is never closed. Add `defer resp.Body.Close()` immediately after the nil error check. Run `go test ./...`.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what you fixed. Now also fix `FetchAll()`: (1) the WaitGroup `Add(1)` is inside the goroutine — move it to before the `go` statement to prevent races; (2) add `defer resp.Body.Close()` inside the goroutine. Run `go vet ./...` to confirm no vet warnings.
Final verification: run `go test -race ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
success_criteria: wg.Add(1) called before launching goroutine, not inside it
